title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Casino Rama, Rama | 2006
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Casino Rama in Rama, Ontario, Canada, on 14 June 2006.

It was the first show by the ninth All-Starr Band, and the first of two consecutive nights in Rama. Their tour of North America lasted for 25 dates in June and July 2006.

Starr had previously performed at the Casino Rama on 26 July 2001 and 24 and 25 July 2003. He returned there on 19 and 20 June 2008, 24 and 25 June 2010, 6 June 2014, and 27 and 28 May 2022.

The ninth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Billy Squier: vocals, guitar
  • Richard Marx: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Rod Argent: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
